cases.name: r1-note4
cases.notes: This is a 30-year-old female seen for headaches. The headaches started two months ago and are worse in the morning. She denies visual changes, nausea, or weakness. She takes ibuprofen as needed. No known drug allergies. She is a nonsmoker. Neurological examination is normal. Assessment is tension-type headache. Plan is to start amitriptyline 10 mg at night. She will follow up in six weeks.
